prompt: Review an unseen batch/stream data-product packet. Design source identity, time semantics, deterministic processing, state/checkpoint recovery, sink commits, quality, lineage, privacy and capacity; recover one injected data incident; and revise the design after the reviewer changes one major scale, lateness, schema, sink, privacy or cost constraint.
deliverables: Consumer decision, SLI, authority and complete data-copy map.
Bounded/unbounded and batch/stream execution decision with alternatives.
Source snapshot/position, schema, event/processing-time, window/watermark/trigger/lateness contract.
Versioned deterministic transform, plan, partition, skew and reference-data design.
State backend, checkpoint storage, restore compatibility, rescale, upgrade and rollback plan.
Transactional/versioned/idempotent sink and output publication boundary.
Quality assertions, populations, severity, quarantine/redrive and reconciliation.
Security, privacy/deletion, retention, observability, capacity/drain and unit-cost model.
Incident timeline, containment, isolated replay, consumer validation, changed-constraint defense and cleanup proof.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies unfamiliar sanitized datasets, distributions, plans, checkpoint history, quality/lineage results and changed constraint.
No production/shared service, real credential, customer data, host network/clock mutation, unbounded source/replay or unknown cleanup.
Every source and output has stable identity/version and every transformation dependency is pinned or recorded.
Event-time finality and late corrections match an explicit consumer contract.
Checkpoint existence is not accepted without representative restore and rollback compatibility evidence.
Repeated execution is safe at the real sink boundary and fault-tested around commit/checkpoint ambiguity.
Quality accounts for accepted/rejected populations and quarantine has owner, retention, privacy and disposition.
Lineage covers failed/replay runs and connects inputs, code/config/schema and outputs without leaking sensitive values.
Recovery calculations use hottest partition, slowest required stage, continuing demand and recovery overhead.
Reviewer observes isolated replay, reconciliation, changed-constraint revision, delayed explanation and exact cleanup.
